Strong match already. The Tar_Spot reference shows the same small black circular dots scattered on the leaf. Now checking Southern_Rust:

Physoderma shows yellowish-tan spots (not black). Tar_Spot remains the best match. Using my last reference view to confirm with another Tar_Spot image:

The test image shows dense black circular dots on a leaf with yellow chlorosis and brown necrotic patches, which is classic advanced Tar_Spot with coalescing necrotic halos.

- Tar_Spot ref 1: identical small black dots scattered on green leaf
- Tar_Spot ref 2: same black raised stromata with necrotic areas — matching the more severe presentation in the test image
- Southern_Rust ruled out (orange pustules, not black)
- Physoderma_Brown_Spot ruled out (yellowish-tan spots, not black)
